name: Dashboard Graphs for Contact Form 7
author: KNEET

sections.description:
Dashboard Graphs for Contact Form 7 adds a new dashboard widget to your WordPress dashboard that displays a stacked bar chart with form submission data per Contact Form 7 form.

How it works:
* The plugin works standalone and automatically stores all new form submissions in its own database table
* If you have the Flamingo plugin installed, it will also use historical data from Flamingo
* Flamingo is recommended (but not required) if you want to see historical data from before this plugin was installed

Features:
* Stacked bar chart with submission data per form
* Choice between last 7, 14 or 30 days
* Automatic color coding per form
* Responsive design
* Shows only forms with submissions
* Works with Flamingo plugin (recommended) or CF7 Database extensions

Translations

This plugin is available in the following languages:
* Dutch (nl_NL)
* Dutch (Belgium) (nl_BE)
* German (de_DE)
* French (fr_FR)
* English (en_US)

Languages

nl_NL

Toont een gestapelde balkgrafiek met formulierinzendingen per Contact Form 7 formulier op het WordPress dashboard. Vereist Contact Form 7 en Flamingo plugin.

Belangrijk: Deze plugin vereist zowel Contact Form 7 als de Flamingo plugin om correct te functioneren. Flamingo slaat de formulierinzendingen op die deze plugin gebruikt om de grafieken te genereren.

Functies:
* Gestapelde balkgrafiek met inzendingen per formulier
* Keuze tussen laatste 7, 14 of 30 dagen
* Automatische kleurcodering per formulier
* Responsive design
* Toont alleen formulieren met inzendingen
* Werkt met Flamingo plugin (vereist) of CF7 Database extensies als fallback

Zeigt ein gestapeltes Balkendiagramm mit Formularübermittlungen pro Contact Form 7 Formular im WordPress-Dashboard. Erfordert Contact Form 7 und Flamingo-Plugin.

Wichtig: Dieses Plugin erfordert sowohl Contact Form 7 als auch das Flamingo-Plugin, um ordnungsgemäß zu funktionieren. Flamingo speichert die Formularübermittlungen, die dieses Plugin zur Generierung der Diagramme verwendet.

Funktionen:

Affiche un graphique en barres empilées avec les données de soumission de formulaire par formulaire Contact Form 7 sur le tableau de bord WordPress. Nécessite Contact Form 7 et le plugin Flamingo.

Important: Ce plugin nécessite à la fois Contact Form 7 et le plugin Flamingo pour fonctionner correctement. Flamingo stocke les soumissions de formulaires que ce plugin utilise pour générer les graphiques.

Fonctionnalités:
* Graphique en barres empilées avec soumissions par formulaire
* Choix entre les 7, 14 ou 30 derniers jours
* Codage couleur automatique par formulaire
* Design responsive
* Affiche uniquement les formulaires avec soumissions
* Fonctionne avec le plugin Flamingo (requis) ou les extensions CF7 Database en secours
sections.installation:
1. Make sure you have Contact Form 7 installed and activated
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cf7-graphs directory
  3. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Go to your WordPress dashboard to see the new widget

Optional: The Flamingo plugin (by Takayuki Miyoshi) is recommended if you want to view historical form submissions from before this plugin was installed. The plugin works perfectly fine without Flamingo and will automatically start tracking all new submissions.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Contact Form 7?

Yes, this plugin requires Contact Form 7 to function.

Do I need the Flamingo plugin?

No, the Flamingo plugin is not required. This plugin works standalone and automatically stores all form submissions in its own database table. However, Flamingo is recommended if you want to view historical data from before this plugin was installed. If you have Flamingo, the plugin will combine data from both sources.

What WordPress version do I need?

Minimum WordPress 5.0.

What PHP version do I need?

Minimum PHP 7.2.

Which forms are shown in the graph?

Only forms that have submissions in the selected time period are shown in the graph.
